t: Totality is where you run your coaching. You build programmes, run sessions with clients, read their weekly check-ins and food logs, book appointments, message them and take payments, all in one app. Your clients use the same app on their side to train, log food and check in with you. This guide covers everything a trainer can do, whether you work for yourself or inside a gym that uses Totality. Where the two work differently, the page says so. Home for an independent trainer Home for a trainer at a gym. Classes show in Today

Independent trainer or gym trainer? # There are two kinds of trainer account. Work out which one you are, because a few things change. Independent trainer Trainer at a gym Who pays for Totality You. Start on the 7 day trial, then Free or a Solo plan Your gym. You pay nothing Client limit Your plan's limit (3 on Free, 5 to 200 on Solo plans) Shared across the whole gym's plan Tali AI credits Your plan's monthly credits Shared with everyone at the gym Payments Go to your own Stripe account (with the POS add-on) Go to the gym's account Extra screens Revenue, My Products, Branding Gym Members, Classes, My shifts You become a gym trainer when a gym invites you and you accept. See Joining a gym .

s: How the app is laid out
t: How the app is laid out # Five tabs sit along the bottom: Clients : your roster. Tap a client to see everything about them. Schedule : your week of PT sessions (and classes, at a gym). Book from here. Home (the middle tab): Tali's brief, Today, your shortcuts and the week at a glance. Check-Ins : weekly check-ins from your clients, waiting for your reply. Messages : chats with each client, and a message to all of them at once. Everything else is a shortcut on Home: My Programmes, Exercise Library, Auto-Regulation, Reports, POS, Shop, My Training, My Nutrition, Calorie Calc and Settings. The purple ? button that floats in the corner of every screen opens Report an Issue , which sends a ticket straight to the Totality team.

Where to start # Sign up and take the short tour. Invite your first client . Build a programme and assign it to them. Run a session together, or let them train on their own. Tali says Start with one real client and one simple programme. Everything else in here makes more sense once someone's actually training in it.

Where Totality runs # Totality runs on iPhone, Android and the web at totalityapp.com.au . Your account is the same everywhere, so you can build programmes on a laptop and run sessions on your phone. Push notifications only come through the phone app. Updates arrive over the air. If something in this guide looks different to your screen, close the app fully and open it again to load the latest version.

Questions # Is Totality free for trainers? Independent trainers can stay on the Free plan for as long as they like, with up to 3 clients and no Tali AI. Every new account starts with a 7 day trial of everything. Trainers at a gym are covered by the gym's plan. See Plans and prices . Do my clients pay for the app? No. Your clients use Totality for free as your clients. You can charge them for your coaching through Totality if you want to. See Getting paid . I also own a gym. Is this the right guide? This guide is for trainers. Gym owners and admins have their own guide with the admin portal, members, billing and staff. Can I use Totality on a computer? Yes. Go to totalityapp.com.au in any browser and log in with the same email and password.

t: Every new independent trainer starts with 7 days of everything. When the trial ends you drop to Free automatically, with no card needed and no lock. You only pay when you pick a Solo plan. All prices are in Australian dollars. If you work at a gym on Totality, your gym pays and none of this applies to you. Skip to Trainers at a gym .

The 7 day trial # Trial - Everything is open: programmes, sessions, check-ins, nutrition, messaging, scheduling, auto-regulation. - Up to 3 clients . - 50 Tali AI credits to try Tali. - No card needed. When the trial has 2 days or fewer left, a banner on Home counts down. On the last day it reads "Last day of your trial. Tomorrow you move to Free, or pick a plan to keep Tali". You also get a reminder email 3 days before it ends. Subscription during the trial

The Free plan # Free Free is yours for as long as you like. Up to 3 clients . Every Solo tool: programme builder, session logging, client check-ins, nutrition tracking, messaging, appointments and scheduling, the auto-regulation engine and push notifications. No Tali AI . Her spot on Home shows what she does and a See plans button. Add-ons (POS, Tali AI, Branding) come with a Solo plan, so they are not offered on Free. Trainers at a gym # If you work at a gym on Totality, the gym's plan covers you. You don't pay anything and there's nothing to choose. Your Subscription screen shows Gym Partner , the gym's plan and how many of the gym's member spots are used. Your client limit is the gym's limit, shared across every trainer there. Tali credits are shared across the gym. Your gym admin can add more. POS payments go to the gym's Stripe account, not yours. Subscription for a trainer at a gym

Questions # What happens to my clients when the trial ends? Nothing. You keep your 3 clients, their programmes and all their history on Free. Tali switches off. Pick a Solo plan any time to get her back and add more clients. I had more than 3 clients and moved to Free. Do I lose them? No one is deleted. You just can't add a new client while you're at or over 3. Archive clients you no longer coach to get under the limit, or pick a Solo plan. Can I switch between monthly and yearly? Yes. Open Settings > Manage Subscription > Change Plan , pick Monthly or Yearly · Save 15% , then Switch to this plan . Do I need a card for the trial? No. You only enter a card when you subscribe to a Solo plan. What does "Up to 5 clients" count? Active clients on your list. Archived clients are not counted.

Create your account # Open Totality on your phone, or go to totalityapp.com.au , and tap Get Started: It's Free . Fill in First name , Email address , Password and Confirm password . Last name is optional. Got a referral code from another trainer or gym? Type it in Referral code . If you opened a referral link, the code is already filled in. Tap Create Account . t: Tell Totality how you'll use it # The first time you log in you land on Welcome to Totality , which confirms your 7 day free trial has started. Under How will you use Totality? pick Solo Trainer ("Just me and my clients"). Add a Business name if you have one. It's optional. Tap Let's Go → . Pick Solo Trainer Gym / Studio is for gym owners who manage a team. It creates a gym and makes you its admin. If you're a trainer who works at someone else's gym, pick Solo Trainer and accept the gym's invite when it arrives. See Joining a gym . Welcome to Totality Add a profile photo, or skip

Add a profile photo # Let's set up your account asks for a profile photo. Tap the circle to pick one, or tap Skip for now . Clients see your photo in messages. Tap Let's Go → and Totality takes you to Home and starts the tour.

Logging in next time # Open the app and tap Log In . Use the same email and password on your phone and on the web. Forgot your password? Tap Forgot Password? on the login screen, enter your email, and Totality emails you a reset link.

Questions # I never got the confirmation email. Check your spam or promotions folder. The email comes from Totality. If it still hasn't arrived after a few minutes, email admintotality@gmail.com with the address you used. It says an account with this email already exists. You (or a gym) already made an account with that email. Tap Log In instead. If you don't know the password, reset it from the login screen. My gym told me to sign up. Should I pick Gym / Studio? No. Pick Solo Trainer . The gym sends you an invite, and when you accept you become a trainer at that gym. Can I change my business name later? The name your clients see can be set in Settings > Branding with the Branding add-on. See Branding . Your own first and last name are in Settings > Profile .

t: When a gym that uses Totality wants you on its team, the gym admin sends you an invite. Nothing is linked until you accept, and the gym can't see your profile or clients before then.

Accept an invite # Open Totality. The invite shows as a banner at the top of Home: "Iron Works invited you to join as a trainer". Tap Accept , or Decline if it's not for you. Read the Join this gym? message, then tap Join (or Not now ). You see "Welcome. You have joined Iron Works." Home reloads as a gym trainer straight away. The invite banner on Home Join this gym? explains what changes If you don't have a Totality account yet, sign up first as a Solo Trainer with the same email the gym used. See Signing up .

What changes when you join # The gym can see your clients and training data. Your own billing ends. Anything you pay for yourself on Totality ends at the end of its current period: your Solo plan, add-ons such as POS, Tali AI and Branding, and any paid membership you had at this gym. You won't be charged twice. Your own branding stops when it ends. The gym's branding applies instead. Your client limit becomes the gym's limit, shared across the gym. Tali credits come from the gym's shared pool. POS payments go to the gym's Stripe account. Your own Stripe payouts, My Products and the Revenue tile are for independent trainers only. New screens appear: Gym Members , Classes , My shifts on Schedule, a Message gym admin thread, and the gym's programme Collection . Credits are always on. The gym manages PT credits, so bookings for gym clients always use them. See Credits . If Totality can't stop your own billing for some reason, you see Joined, but check your billing with an Open Billing button. Use it to cancel what's left in Stripe so you aren't charged twice.

t: You add a client by inviting them. Totality creates their account and emails them their login. They set their own password the first time they log in.

Invite a client # Tap Invite on the Clients tab, or the Invite Client tile on Home. Type their Full Name and Email . Tap Invite Client . On Client Invited! you see their temporary password and "Invite email sent to" their address. Tap Done . Invite Client Client Invited! with the temporary password The client gets an email from Totality with their email address and temporary password. When they first log in they're asked to set a new password, then they answer a short onboarding questionnaire (goal, experience, training days, injuries and so on). You see those answers on their profile.

If the email doesn't send # If the invite email fails, you see "Email not sent: share credentials manually". The account is still created. Tap Share Credentials to send the login yourself by text, email or any app. On the web it copies the details to your clipboard. You can tap Share Credentials even when the email did send, which is handy if the client can't find it.

Free That's your 3 on Free : archive a client or pick a Solo plan A Solo plan Client limit reached : your plan's limit, with an Upgrade button A gym Client limit reached : the gym's plan is full. Questions # My client says they never got the email. Ask them to check spam. If you are still on the Client Invited! screen, use Share Credentials . If not, ask them to tap Forgot Password? on the login screen with the email you used, which sends them a reset link. Can I invite someone who already has a Totality account? Not from Invite Client. If the email is already registered you get an error saying so, and nothing is created. Email admintotality@gmail.com with the client's name and email and the team can link them to you. Is there a cost per client? No. Your plan sets how many active clients you can have. Clients don't pay for the app. Can my client use Totality Nutrition too? Yes, with the same email and password. What they log in Totality Nutrition shows in their nutrition on your side. See My nutrition .

t: The Clients tab (titled My Clients ) is your whole roster. Tap any client to open their profile. Pull down to refresh. My Clients

What each row shows # Name and email. The programme they're on, or "No programme assigned yet". An Archive button on the right. At the top you see how many clients you have against your limit, for example "6 of 20 clients". At the limit the count turns red and a note explains how to make room.

Search, sort and filter # Search clients by name filters as you type. Sort : Name , Last active or Newest (most recently added first). At risk shows only clients with no app activity for 14 days or more. The number in brackets is how many. Archived switches to your archived clients.

Archive a client # Archive clients you no longer coach. They stay in your history, and they stop counting towards your client limit. Tap Archive on the client's row. Read Archive client? and confirm. To bring someone back, tap Archived , then Unarchive on their row. Unarchiving counts them again, so it won't work if you're already at your limit. Archive client? At the limit on Free, with the note Archived clients drop off Home, Check-ins, Messages and the programme assign list. Their history is kept.

Removing a client completely # There's no delete button for clients. Archive them instead. If a client wants their account deleted, they can do it themselves from their own Settings, or email admintotality@gmail.com.

Questions # Does archiving tell the client? No. Nothing is sent to them. Can an archived client still log in? Yes. Their account still exists. Archiving only removes them from your active roster. Why is someone "At risk" when I saw them at the gym this week? At risk uses the last time the client was active in the Totality app. A client who trains with you in person but never opens the app shows as at risk after 14 days. Clients who have never been active in the app also show here. At a gym, why does the limit look bigger than my client count? Gym trainers share the gym's limit, which counts members across the whole gym, not just your clients.

t: Tap a client anywhere in the app to open their profile. It's one long page, top to bottom, with everything you need to coach them. Here is every section in order. The top of a client profile

Gone quiet (only when it applies) # If the client hasn't been active in the app for 14 days or more, a card at the top says "Zack has gone quiet" with when they were last active. Draft a nudge with Tali writes a friendly message in your voice for you to edit and send. See Waiting on you .

Recent nutrition # The last 7 days of food, newest first. Each day shows calories against their target with a progress bar and their protein, carbs and fat. Tap a day to expand it and see every meal and food. See Client nutrition .

Weight and measurements # Current Weight and Change across their last entries. Latest Measurements : chest, waist, hips, arms and thighs, with the date measured. Weight trend : a graph of their daily weigh-ins and a 7 day trend line. Strength progress : estimated one rep max over time for their main lifts. Weight, measurements and trend Assigned programme with Run Session
Progress photos # Shows the client's recent progress photos when they've uploaded any.

Assigned programme # Every programme assigned to the client. The main one is marked PRIMARY . If they have more than one, tap Set as Primary on another to make it the main one. Tap the week picker (for example Week 3 (4 sessions) ▾ ) to choose a week. Each session has Run Session → to start a live session with the client. See Running a session . Remove from client takes the programme off their profile. Their logged history stays. No programme yet? Tap Go to Programmes and assign one. See Assigning a programme .

Nutrition targets # Their daily calories, protein, carbs and fat, any note, and the date you set them. Set Targets or Update Targets opens the form, and Calculator works the numbers out for you. See Client nutrition .

Onboarding info # The client's answers from their first login: primary goal, experience, training days a week, preferred style, current and goal weight, height, date of birth, whether they're pregnant or breastfeeding, and injuries or limitations. Until they finish it, this says "Client will complete the questionnaire on first login". Onboarding info PT credits and payment

PT credits # How many session credits the client has: Available , This week and Used . If they're on a weekly PT package, its name and credits per week show at the top. Add Credit adds one credit by hand. Generate this week creates this week's credits from their package (only when they have a package). Sell PT packages (independent trainers) opens My Products so clients can buy credits. See Credits and settling sessions .

Payment # POS Shows only when you can take payments: independent trainers with the POS add-on, or gym trainers when the gym has POS. The card on file, for example "Visa ending 4242", or "No payment method on file". Request Payment Method sends the client a notification to add a card. Add Card Manually lets you enter their card with them. Send payment link (POS) opens POS with this client already picked. See Payment links .
Recent session logs # Tap the heading to expand the client's latest logged sets. Full history → opens every session they've done. See Session history .
Client activity log # Activities the client logged themselves, like a run or a mobility session, marked Client logged .
Private notes # Notes for you, never shown to the client. Type in Add a private note... and tap Save Note . Each note shows who wrote it and when. Activity log and private notes

Questions # Can the client see my private notes? No. Private notes never show in the client's app. How do I message this client from their profile? Open the Messages tab and tap their name. See Messaging . Their weight shows 0 kg. They haven't logged a weight yet. Weight comes from the weigh-ins the client logs in their app. Why can't I see the Payment section? It only shows when POS is on: the POS add-on for independent trainers, or the gym's POS for gym trainers.

Each row shows the member's name, plan and start date, their status, and Your client if they're one of yours. Other trainers and staff at the gym are not listed. Only members are.

t: A programme is a block of training: a number of weeks, each with sessions on set days, each session with its exercises. You build it once and assign it to as many clients as you like. Open My Programmes from the Home shortcuts. My Programmes New Programme

Your programmes # Each card shows the programme's name, description, length in weeks, and a pill with who it's assigned to (a client's name, or "2 clients"). Tap a card to open it in the programme builder . The ⋮ on each card opens a menu: Duplicate makes a full copy, sessions and exercises included, with "(copy)" added to the name. Handy for a new block based on an old one. Share to Collection (at a gym) lets other trainers at your gym see and copy it. Remove from Collection stops sharing.

Create a programme # Tap + New . Type a Programme Name , for example "4-Week Strength Block". Add a Description if you want, and the Duration (weeks) . Under Assign to Client (optional) pick a client, or leave it as "No client selected". Tap Create . The programme opens in the builder so you can add sessions.

Draft it with Tali # Paid Trial In the New Programme sheet, Draft it with Tali builds the first draft for you using only exercises from your library. It uses 5 credits. Tap Draft it with Tali . Write The brief : the client, their goal, equipment and any injuries. Pick Days a week (2 to 6) and Weeks (4, 6, 8 or 12). Pick a client under For a client (optional) and Tali also reads their onboarding answers. Tap Let Tali build it . Check the preview, rename it if you like, then Create programme . You land in the builder to tweak sets, reps and exercises. On the Free plan the button reads Add Tali and opens your plans instead. Draft a programme with Tali

Collection (gym trainers) # The Collection tab shows programmes other trainers at your gym have shared. Filter by tag. Open one to view it, then tap Copy to my programmes to get your own editable copy. The Collection at Iron Works Independent trainers see an empty Collection, because it's shared within a gym.

Questions # Can I use one programme for several clients? Yes. Assign it to as many clients as you like. Each client's progress is tracked separately. If I edit a programme, do my clients see the change? Yes. Clients on that programme see the updated sessions next time they open it. Duplicate it first if you want a separate version for one client. Can I delete a programme? Yes. Open it, tap Functions , then Delete . Every session and exercise inside it is deleted too, and it can't be undone. If you only want it off one client, use Remove from client on their profile instead, which keeps the programme in your library and their past workouts. Can I share a programme with a trainer outside my gym? No. The Collection is only within your gym. You can sell a programme on the marketplace instead. See Marketplace .

t: Open a programme from My Programmes to build it. The builder shows the programme week by week. Each session card shows its day, name, block type and intensity. A programme, week by week The Functions menu

Add a session # Tap + Add Workout to Week 1 under any week (or + Add Session on an empty programme). Give it a Session Name , for example "Upper Body A" or "Leg Day". Pick one or more Days (Mon to Sun). Pick one or more Weeks . The same session is created on every day and week you tick. Optional: a Block Type (Hypertrophy, Strength, Power, Deload, General) and Intensity (Low, Moderate, High, Max). They show as coloured tags. Tap Add Session . Then tap the session to add exercises. See The session builder . Add Session

Edit or move a session # Tap the pencil on a session card to open Edit Session . Change its name, block type or intensity, or tick other days and weeks. Ticking extra days copies the session there. Unticking the original day or week moves it. Delete Session removes it.

Copy or delete a week # Each week header has two buttons: Copy week copies every session in that week, exercises included, into the weeks you pick. Delete week removes every session in that week. A quick way to build an 8 week block: set up week 1 properly, then copy it into weeks 2 to 8 and adjust the loads.

The Functions menu # Tap Functions at the top right: Assign to Me : put the programme on your own training. See My training . Assign to Client : see below. Edit Programme : change the name, description and duration. At a gym you can also switch on Share to Collection and add Tags (comma separated) so other trainers can find it. Extend to N weeks : repeats your sessions into new weeks. If the programme's duration is longer than the weeks you've built, it fills up to the duration. Otherwise it adds 4 more weeks. Delete : deletes the programme and everything in it. This can't be undone.

Assign a programme # Tap Functions , then Assign to Client . Pick a Start date : Today , Next Monday or Pick a date . Tick one or more clients. Tap Confirm . The client sees the programme in their app straight away, starting on the date you picked. Clients who already have this programme keep their current start date unless you change it here. Assign to Client A client can have more than one programme. One is marked PRIMARY as their main programme. You can change which one is primary on their profile .
Viewing someone else's programme # Programmes from your gym's Collection open read only. Tap Copy to my programmes to get your own copy you can edit.

Questions # I ticked the wrong week. How do I undo it? Open the extra copy of the session with the pencil and tap Delete Session , or use Delete week if the whole week is wrong. Can I have two sessions on the same day? Yes. Add a second session and tick the same day, for example an AM and a PM session. Why does assigning say "Partly assigned"? One of the clients couldn't be given the programme, usually because another trainer already has it assigned to them. The rest were assigned. How do I take a programme off a client? Open the client's profile and tap Remove from client under their programme.

t: Tap a session in the programme builder to open it. This is where you add the exercises and set the targets your client sees and logs against. A session with a superset Editing an exercise

Add exercises # Tap + Add Exercise . Search, or tap Filters to narrow by Muscle group , Equipment and Goal . Tick every exercise you want. Tap Add N Exercises . Can't find it? Tap Create New Exercise at the top of the list. Give it a name, primary muscle group, equipment, difficulty, load type, form notes and an optional video (upload a file under 50MB or paste a YouTube link), then Create & Add to Session . It's added to the library too. Add Exercises

Set the targets # Tap Edit on an exercise card to open its targets: Tracking Type : Reps , or Time (seconds) for holds and timed work. Sets , and Reps (or range) such as "8-10". For time based exercises, a duration in minutes and seconds. Quick Select buttons for common rep schemes. Weight in your lifting unit, and Rest (seconds) . Warm-up Sets : these show to the client first and don't count toward their progress bar. Tempo (optional) : four numbers like 3-1-2-0. Totality spells it out in plain words underneath ("3 sec down, 1 sec pause at the bottom..."). Use X for an explosive part. Per Side : the client logs left and right separately. Load Type (Read-Only) : comes from the exercise in the library (External, Bodyweight, Banded, Banded + Weight). It decides what the client fills in. Set Type : Normal, Superset, Drop Set, Myo Reps, AMRAP, Giant Set or Rest-Pause. Each one has a short explanation under it, and the client sees the same how-to when they train. AMRAP lets you set a rep target. Superset Group (optional) : give exercises the same number to bracket them together with A, B, C badges. Coach notes (optional) : cues like "Keep elbows tucked, pause at bottom". Tap Save Change
Reorder or remove # Tap Reorder at the top, then use the up and down arrows on each exercise. Tap the ✕ on a card to remove that exercise from the session.

Copy a session # Copy from Week N (on any week after week 1) copies every exercise from the same day last week. Great for progressive blocks. Copy at the top copies this whole session to another programme. Pick the programme, the week and the day. Delete at the top deletes the session.

Questions # My client can't see the weight I set. Check the exercise's load type. Bodyweight exercises ask the client for added weight only. What's the difference between a superset and a giant set? A superset pairs two or more exercises back to back with no rest. A giant set is three or more exercises in a row for the same muscle group. Either way, give the exercises the same Superset Group number to bracket them together. The group number works separately from the set type. Can I change an exercise's load type here? No. Load type belongs to the exercise. Change it in the Exercise library if you created the exercise.

t: The Exercise Library tile on Home opens every exercise you can use in a programme. It includes Totality's built-in exercises, exercises other trainers have added, and your gym's own exercises (marked Gym ). The exercise library An exercise with its video and cues

Find an exercise # Type in Search exercises... . Tap the sliders button to open Filter : Goal (Strength, Hypertrophy, Endurance, Mobility, Power, Rehabilitation), Muscle Group and Equipment . Tap Apply , or Clear all to reset. Each row shows the name, the main muscles, the difficulty, and a play button when there's a video.

Exercise details # Tap an exercise to see: The video. YouTube videos open with Watch on YouTube . Muscles Targeted and equipment. Description and Why It's Effective . Best Used For . Recommended Rep Ranges . Coaching Cues . Clients see the same cues and video when they train, so it's worth filling these in on your own exercises.

Add your own exercise # Tap Add at the top. Enter a Name , then pick Difficulty . Type the Muscle Groups and Equipment , comma separated. Pick the Load Type : External Weight, Bodyweight, Banded, or Banded + Weight. This controls what weight boxes the client sees when logging. Fill in Description, Why It's Effective, Coaching Cues, Recommended Rep Ranges, Goals and Use Cases as much as you like. Under Exercise Video , tap Upload Video (under 50MB) or paste a YouTube link. Tap Save . New Exercise Exercises you add join the shared library, so other Totality trainers can use them too. You can edit the ones you created (they show a pencil). You can't delete exercises. If you need one removed, email admintotality@gmail.com.

Questions # Can I edit a built-in exercise? No. You can only edit exercises you created. Create your own version with your own cues if you want something different. Which video formats work? Any video file under 50MB, or a YouTube link. Can clients browse the library? Yes. Clients have an exercise library in their own app, and they see each exercise's cues and video when they train.

t: Auto-regulation watches how hard your clients rate their sets (RPE) and flags exercises where the load probably needs changing. You decide: nothing changes for the client until you approve a flag. Open Auto-Regulation from the Home shortcuts. The red badge on the tile is how many flags are waiting. Pending flags Approve flag?

When a flag appears # Every time a session is saved (by the client or by you), Totality looks at the last 4 weeks of that client's sets that have an RPE: Average RPE of 9 or more on an exercise: a Reduce Load flag, "Reduce load by 5-10% next session". Average RPE of 5 or less : an Increase Load flag, "Increase load by 5-10% next session". Only one pending flag per exercise per client is created at a time. Exercises without RPE logged are never flagged, so ask clients to fill in RPE.

Review a flag # Each card shows the flag type, how long ago it was raised, the client, the exercise, the Reason (for example "Average RPE of 9.5 over past 4 weeks") and the Recommendation . Approve ✓ : confirm in Approve flag? . Totality takes the client's most recent weight on that exercise and works out a new one: 7.5% lighter for Reduce Load, 7.5% heavier for Increase Load, rounded to the nearest 0.5. The client gets that as a recommended weight the next time they do the exercise, with a Why? explaining the reason. If their notifications are on, they also get a push: "Your trainer adjusted your training load". Dismiss : removes the flag from the list. Nothing changes for the client. When nothing is waiting you see All clear . If the exercise is bodyweight there's no weight to adjust. Approving just clears the flag and says so.

Questions # Does approving change my programme? No. Your programme stays the same. The client gets a recommended weight for that exercise, which shows when they log it. Can I turn auto-regulation off? There's no switch. If you don't want to use it, dismiss flags or ignore the tile. Why did a client get flagged after one session? The average covers all their logged sets for that exercise in the last 4 weeks, so even one session can be enough if it's the only one with RPE.

t: Start a session # There are two ways in: From Home : tap Start next to a booked session in Today . Totality opens the programme session that client is due today. If they're due nothing today, it tells you and offers their profile. From the client profile : under Assigned programme , pick a week and tap Run Session → on any session. Starting from a booking also marks that booking as done once you save the workout. The start of a session Logging sets

t: The screen # At the top, Workout Overview lists every exercise with counts. Tap it to expand. Each exercise card shows: The exercise name, with badges for set types (SS, DS, AMRAP and so on) and L/R if it's per side. The how-to: tempo in plain words, warm-ups, set type explanation, AMRAP target, and Note from your coach . Sets , Target reps (or Duration) and Suggested weight. Four small icons: cues (coaching cues, form cues, why it's effective, rep ranges), history (the client's past sets on this exercise), rest timer, and swap.

p: Running a session with a client
t: Log the sets # Warm-up rows (W1, W2) come first. Fill them in if you like and tap Done . They don't count toward the session. For each working set, enter the weight (or band), the REPS and the RPE . The boxes show the target and "Last:" what the client did last time. Tap Done on the set. The rest timer starts with the rest you set for that exercise. Tap Skip for a set they didn't do. Repeat last set copies the previous set. + Add Set adds an extra one. For per side exercises, log L and R separately. For timed exercises, use the play button to run a countdown. When auto-regulation has a recommended weight for an exercise, it's filled in as the suggestion, and Why? explains it. See Auto-regulation .

p: Running a session with a client
t: The rest timer # The REST bar shows the countdown. Use -15s and +15s to adjust, the preset buttons (1m, 90s, 2m, 3m, 4m) to restart at a set time, or Skip . When rest is over you get "Rest Complete. Time to go!" with a sound, and a notification if your phone is locked.

p: Running a session with a client
t: Swap an exercise # Tap the swap icon to replace an exercise for this session only, for example when the rack is taken. Pick from exercises for the same muscles, or search. The client's programme isn't changed.

p: Running a session with a client
t: Finish # Tap Finish at the top. Totality shows how many sets you logged out of the total, for example "9 of 11 sets logged. Save and finish?". Tap Finish to save, or Keep going . You then see the session summary .

t: Your sets are safe # Every set is saved on your device as you go ("Saved on this device"). If you leave the session or the app closes, your sets come back next time you open it ("Restored your unsaved sets"). If you tap back you're asked Leave session? , and the sets wait on the device.

t: Questions # What if the client already logged this session today? Totality asks "This session was already logged today. Log it again?". Tap Log again to save a second copy, or go back. Can I log a session that isn't in their programme? Not from here. Sessions come from the client's programme. Add the session to their programme first, then run it. Do I have to fill in RPE? No, but auto-regulation only works with RPE, and the session summary uses it. It says "No sets recorded". None of the completed sets had reps, weight, a band or time entered, so nothing was saved. Fill in at least the reps and tap Finish again.

t: Session summary # After you finish a session, Session Complete shows how it went. Tali puts the total weight lifted into perspective (a grand piano, a dairy cow and so on). Below that: The session name and date, and how long it took. Completion : the share of sets done, with a line on the intensity ("Light session", "Good intensity" or "Intense session", based on the average RPE). Avg RPE , Volume (total weight lifted) and Sets Done . Exercise Breakdown : sets done and average RPE for each exercise. Tap Done to go back. Session Complete A client's history, by month

A client's full history # On the client's profile, under Recent session logs , tap Full history → . Their sessions are grouped by month, newest first. Each card shows the date, session name, time, number of sets, total volume and average RPE. Tap a card to expand it and see each exercise with its sets and RPE. The history shows the most recent activity. If a client has a very long history, older sessions may not all show here.
Your own history # Your own sessions live in My Training > History . See My training .

Questions # A client's session isn't in their history. Sessions show once they're saved. If the session was run on a phone that lost signal, open the session again on that phone. The unsaved sets are restored and you can tap Finish . Is volume in kilograms? Volume uses your lifting weight unit from Settings > Units and region . Can I edit a logged session? Not from the history screen.

t: Each week your clients fill in a check-in: how they slept, their energy, soreness, stress and mood, how well they stuck to training and nutrition, their weight, wins, struggles and anything else. You read it and reply. It's the backbone of online coaching.

How check-ins reach you # There's nothing to set up. Every client has a weekly check-in in their app. Check-ins are weekly, keyed to the week ending Sunday. A client can send one per week. Every Sunday at 8am (Sydney time) clients get a reminder by push and email, unless they've turned check-in reminders off. A client can tap Skip This Week instead. Skipped weeks don't count as missed. On Mondays, a client who didn't check in and didn't skip shows "Check-in overdue (missed Sunday)". You get a push when a check-in arrives (if Client submitted a check-in is on in Settings).

The Check-Ins tab # Pending shows check-ins waiting for your reply. All shows every recent one. Each card shows the client, the week, when it was sent, their Energy, Sleep, Mood and Stress scores, and Injury/concern flagged in red if they mentioned one. Pending check-ins One check-in opened

Review and reply # Tap a check-in to open it. Read Ratings (each out of 5 with a word like Good or Mild), Adherence for training and nutrition, Weight , Wins , Struggles , Injuries / concerns and Additional notes . Under Your response , write your feedback. Tap Send Response . You see "Response sent to client." and the client gets a notification. Tap Next check-in (N left) to go straight to the next one, or Close . All caught up means you're done. To change a reply later, open the check-in from All , edit it and tap Update Response . The client is told you updated your feedback.

Draft a reply with Tali # Paid Trial Under Your response , tap Draft a reply with Tali . She reads the whole check-in and writes a reply for you in a few seconds. It uses 1 credit. The draft is marked "Drafted by Tali, read it over". Edit anything. Again writes a fresh draft (another credit). It replaces what's in the box. Nothing is sent until you tap Send Response . Your response Tali's draft, ready to edit Tali says I'll get you most of the way there, but you know them better than I do. Add the one line only you'd say.

Check-ins elsewhere in the app # Home shows Check-ins to review in Today, a count in Your Overview, and Recent Check-Ins . Waiting on you lists every check-in you haven't replied to. Low scores or an injury in a check-in flag the client in Needs Attention on Home.

Questions # Can I change the check-in questions? No. Every client gets the same check-in. Can I change the check-in day? No. Check-ins run weekly to Sunday, with the reminder on Sunday morning. Can clients see their past check-ins and my replies? Yes. Clients have a check-in history in their app with your responses. I don't see a client's check-in. Archived clients drop out of the Check-ins tab. Unarchive them to see their check-ins again.

t: Waiting on you is one list of everything that needs you. Open it from See what's waiting on Tali's brief on Home. Paid Trial Waiting on you Tali's nudge, ready to send

What's in the list # Check-ins to reply to : every check-in you haven't answered, with when it was sent. Tap one to open it in Check-ins, ready for a reply . Gone quiet : clients who haven't been active in the app for 14 days or more, with "Last active N days ago" (or "Not active in the app yet"). Tap the name to open their profile, or tap Draft a nudge . Sessions to settle : sessions marked Pending settlement. Tap one to jump to that day in Schedule with the session open. See Credits and settling sessions . When there's nothing left, Tali says so.

Nudges # A nudge is a short, friendly message to bring a quiet client back. Tali writes it, you send it. Tap Draft a nudge on a client in Gone quiet (or Draft a nudge with Tali on their profile). Tali looks at their activity and writes a message in your voice. It uses 1 credit. Edit anything in the box. Regenerate writes a new one (1 more credit). Tap Send message . It arrives as an in-app message from you, with a notification. Or tap Copy ( Share on a phone) to send it another way. Once you've messaged a client, they drop off Gone quiet for 7 days so you're not nudging twice. Gone quiet on a client's profile

The weekly inactive email # Separately from Tali, Totality emails you a weekly digest listing clients with no activity (sessions, food or check-ins) in the last 14 days. New clients get a 14 day grace period. To stop it, switch off Tips and reports in Settings , or use the Unsubscribe link in the email.

Questions # I'm on Free. Can I still see who's gone quiet? Yes. The At risk filter on the Clients tab shows clients with no app activity for 14 days, and Home flags inactive clients in Needs Attention . Waiting on you and Tali's nudges come with a Solo plan. Does Tali send anything on her own? No. Nothing is sent until you tap Send message . Can I nudge a client without Tali? Yes. Open Messages , tap the client and write to them yourself.

t: Clients log their food in Totality (or in Totality Nutrition with the same login). You see it on their profile and set the targets they aim for.

Read a client's food log # Open the client's profile. Recent nutrition shows the last 7 days: Each day shows calories eaten against their target, with a bar, and their protein, carbs and fat. Tap a day to expand it and see each meal (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snacks) with its totals and every food logged. "No food logged in the last 7 days" means they haven't logged anything recently. Recent nutrition on a client profile Setting targets

Set their targets # Scroll to Nutrition targets on the client's profile. Tap Set Targets (or Update Targets if they already have some). Enter Calories (or Energy in kJ), Protein (g) , Carbs (g) and Fat (g) . You need at least one. Add Notes (optional) , like "Increase protein on training days". The client sees the note. Tap Save Targets . "Nutrition targets updated. Client can see them now." The client's food log in their app now tracks against these numbers.

Use the calculator # Tap Calculator next to Update Targets to work the numbers out with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula. Pick Biological sex . For female clients you can also answer Pregnant or breastfeeding? . Enter Weight , Height and Age . These start from the client's onboarding answers where Totality has them. Pick Gym sessions / week (0 to 7) and Daily steps (Under 5k, 5-10k, 10 to 20k, 20k+). Pick a Goal (Fat Loss, Maintain, Muscle Gain), a Diet (Balanced, High Carb, High Fat, High Protein) and a Pace (Slow, Standard or Fast). Tap Calculate . You see protein first, then BMR, TDEE, the target and the recommended macros. Tap Use These Targets to fill in the targets form, then Save Targets . Calorie Calculator Pregnancy and breastfeeding When a client is pregnant or breastfeeding, the calculator won't suggest a deficit (and no surplus while pregnant), leads with protein, and shows the calories as a minimum . The client's food log then treats that number as a minimum too, so it never shows them as "over". These are estimates. Use your professional judgement and work with their health professional. The Calorie Calc tile on Home opens the same calculator for quick sums, without saving

Units # Targets show in your energy unit (kcal or kJ) from Settings > Units and region . Saved targets are stored the same way whichever unit you use, so a client who uses kJ sees the right number in kJ.

Questions # Can my client change their own targets? Clients see the targets you set in their app. Set or update them here whenever they need to change. Can I see vitamins and minerals? Your own food log has See full breakdown with the nutrient breakdown. On a client's profile you see calories and macros. My client logs in Totality Nutrition. Will I see it? Yes, if they use the same email and password for both apps. It's one account and one food log.

t: Trainers get the same food log as clients. Open My Nutrition from the Home shortcuts. My Nutrition Add food

The day view # Use ‹ and › to move between days. You can go back up to 7 days. The top card shows calories eaten and remaining, with bars for Protein , Carbs and Fat against your targets. See full breakdown opens every nutrient for the day. Meals are Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snack. Tap Add Another Snack for Snack 2 to 5. Each meal shows its totals. Use the arrows to collapse or expand it.

Set your targets # Tap Set Targets at the top. Enter your Daily Calorie Target (or Daily Energy Target in kJ), Protein , Carbs and Fat , then Save Targets . Need help with the numbers? Use Calorie Calc on Home first.

Add food # Tap + on a meal, then add food one of these ways: Search : type in Search foods... . Results come from the Australian food database first, then Open Food Facts for packaged foods. The settings button filters by Brand . Favourites and recent foods show before you search. Scan a barcode : tap the phone button next to the search box and point your camera at the barcode. On the web this needs camera permission. Ask Tali : tap Describe your meal to Tali and type what you ate, like "2 eggs on toast and a flat white". Tali splits it into foods with amounts. Check the list, change anything, pick the meal and add it. Describing meals uses no credits, with a daily limit. It needs Tali on your plan. Manual entry : tap Manual entry and type the food name, serving size and macros. When you pick a food, change the serving in grams and the macros update as you type. If a label looks wrong, you can correct the per 100g numbers before adding. Tap Add to Dinner (or whichever meal).
Change or delete an entry # Tap a food to adjust its serving size or correct the numbers, then Save . Tap the bin to delete it.

Saved meals # Tap the star on a meal to save everything in it as one meal, with a name like "Breakfast: Mon 4 Aug". To log it again, tap Saved Meals at the bottom of the day, then Log this meal and pick which meal to add it to. Saved Meals

Totality Nutrition # Totality Nutrition is our food tracking app for anyone. It uses the same account as Totality, so if you or your clients log in with the same email and password, it's the same food log. Food logged in Totality Nutrition shows here and on a client's profile, and the other way round. Totality members get 50% off the Nutrition plan. See the Totality Nutrition guide for its own features.

Questions # The scanner says "Not Found". That product isn't in the food databases yet. Search by name, or use Manual entry . Can I log yesterday's food? Yes. Use ‹ to go back a day (up to 7 days), then add to the meal. Do my clients see my food log? No. Your food log is yours.

t: The Schedule tab is your week of PT sessions. At a gym it also shows the classes you teach and your rostered shifts. Your week Book Appointment

Find your way around # The week strip shows Monday to Sunday. Use ‹ and › to change weeks. Dots mark days with sessions. Tap a day to see its sessions, sorted by time. Each session shows the time, length, client, and any note. Completed sessions are marked. Sessions still to do have a green Complete button. Cash off week settles every pending session in the week at once. See Credits . Classes at the top opens the gym's class timetable (gym trainers). See Classes . Pull down to refresh.

Book a session # Tap Book . Pick the Client . The number next to each name is how many credits they have. Pick the Date . Pick a Start time from the Morning, Afternoon and Evening slots (every 30 minutes, 6am to 9:30pm). Pick a Duration : 30, 45, 60, 75 or 90 minutes. Add Notes (optional) , like "Bring lifting shoes". For a regular slot, switch on Recurring (weekly) and pick the Number of weeks : 4, 6, 8, 12 or 16. Tap Book session . If you've connected Google Calendar , the times you're busy in Google show under the slots. Picking a busy time asks Busy in Google Calendar first, with Book anyway . With the credit system on, booking uses one of the client's credits. If they have none, the session is still booked and marked Pending Settlement . You see a message telling you which happened. See Credits and settling sessions .

Session details # Tap a session to open Session details : client, date, time, status, whether it's part of a weekly series, whether a credit was used, and notes. Session details From here: Start session opens the live session for the client. See Running a session . Mark complete marks it done. Mark no-show (credit kept) records a no-show. The credit stays used. Cancel session cancels it. If a credit was used, it goes back to the client. For a recurring series you choose This session only or All future sessions .
Shifts (gym trainers) # If your gym rosters you, My shifts shows your shifts for the next 14 days at the top of Schedule, with times and your role. Shifts are set by the gym admin.

Questions # Can my clients book themselves? No. You book PT sessions. Clients see them in their app as read only, with a link to message you if they need a change. Can I see my sessions in my phone's calendar? Yes. Connect Google Calendar, or add the calendar link to Google or Apple Calendar. See Calendar sync . I booked the wrong time. Open the session, tap Cancel session , and book it again at the right time. Any credit goes back to the client.

t: Credits are how Totality keeps track of paid sessions. One credit pays for one PT session. When you book a session, a credit is used. When there isn't one, the session waits as Pending Settlement until it's paid for.

p: PT credits, packages and settling sessions
t: The credit system switch # Independent trainers choose. In Settings > POS & BILLING , the Credit System switch decides. When it's on, bookings use credits. When it's off, bookings don't touch credits and nothing is ever pending. Turning it off asks Disable credit system? first. Trainers at a gym don't have a switch. The gym manages credits, so bookings for gym clients always use them. The Credit System switch (independent) At a gym, the gym manages credits

p: PT credits, packages and settling sessions
t: Where credits come from # PT packages : a client on a weekly package (for example "3 x week PT") gets that many credits each week. The package name shows on their profile under PT credits . Gym packages are set up by the gym admin. Generate this week : on the client's profile, creates this week's credits from their package if they haven't been made yet. Add Credit : on the client's profile, adds one credit by hand. Use it when a client pays you outside the app. Selling packages (independent trainers): create a PT Package product in My Products . When a client buys it, they get that many credits. The client's profile shows Available , This week and Used . Credits can have an expiry date. Expired credits don't count as available. PT credits on a client profile

t: What happens to credits # What you do Credit Book a session and the client has a credit One credit is used Book when they have none Session is Pending Settlement , no credit used Cancel a session that used a credit The credit goes back to the client Mark a no-show The credit stays used

t: There are two ways to get your Totality bookings into your calendar. Both are in Settings . Google Calendar and Calendar sync in Settings

Google Calendar, two-way # This sends your PT sessions into your Google Calendar as they're booked, moved or cancelled. It also reads when you're busy in Google, so those times show as busy when you book in Totality. Totality only sees busy or free, never what your other events are. Go to Settings > Google Calendar . Tap Connect Google Calendar . Sign in with Google and allow calendar access. Tick the calendar box Google asks about. Come back to Totality. You see "Connected. Your sessions are going into Google Calendar now, and your busy times will show in the booking picker." Google may show a "Google hasn't verified this app" page while this is new. Tap Advanced , then Continue . Once connected you can Reconnect Google or Disconnect . Disconnecting stops new sessions going in and busy times showing. Sessions already in your calendar stay there.

Calendar sync, one-way # A private link that Google Calendar or Apple Calendar subscribes to. It shows your booked sessions, classes and appointments, and keeps them up to date. Use this for Apple or Outlook, or if you'd rather not connect Google. Add to Google Calendar or Add to Apple Calendar adds it in one tap. Copy link ( Share link on a phone) gives you the link to paste into any calendar app under "Subscribe" or "Add calendar from URL". Reset link makes a new link. Any calendar using the old one stops updating, so you'll need to add it again. Keep the link private. Apple Calendar updates within the hour. Google Calendar can take a few hours. Calendar sync

Questions # Do I need both? No. Use Google Calendar two-way if you use Google. Use the one-way link for Apple or Outlook. A session I cancelled is still in my calendar. With Google two-way it's removed straight away. With the one-way link, wait for your calendar to refresh (up to a few hours on Google). Can my clients see my calendar? No. Totality only reads busy or free, and only for your own bookings. It says "That link timed out." The Google sign-in took too long. Tap Connect Google Calendar and try again.

t: The Messages tab is direct messaging with your clients. A red badge on the tab shows how many unread messages you have. Messages A conversation

Your inbox # Totality (Announcement) at the top holds news from Totality. It's read only. At a gym, Iron Works (Gym admin) (your gym's name) is always there so you can message your gym admin. Then every client, with their last message, the time and an unread count. Clients you haven't messaged show "No messages yet. Say hello!". Search clients... finds a client by name. The list updates live as messages arrive. At a gym, the gym admin thread sits near the top

Chat with a client # Tap the client. Type in Message (name)... . Tap the send arrow. The client gets a notification "New message from Sam" (with your name). If a message fails to send, it shows "Not sent. Tap to retry" and your text goes back in the box, so nothing is lost.

Templates # Tap the template button next to the message box to insert a saved message. Built-in templates are Check-in reminder , Great week , Missed session , New programme and Schedule change . Type a message, then Save current message as a template with a name to add your own. Delete your own templates from the same list. Built-in ones are marked Built in .

Message all clients # Tap Message all clients at the top of Messages. Write your message (up to 1,000 characters), or tap Templates . Tap Send to N clients and confirm. Each active client gets it as a normal message from you in their own thread, with a notification. Archived clients are left out. You see progress while it sends, then a summary. If any fail, Retry failed sends to those again. Message all clients
Messages from Tali # Nudges you send from Waiting on you arrive in the client's thread as normal messages from you.

Questions # Can clients message each other? No. Clients message you (and the gym, at a gym). They can't see other clients. Can I send photos or files? Messages are text only. I'm not getting notified of new messages. Check Settings > Notifications > Messages is on, and that notifications for Totality are allowed in your phone's settings. Push notifications only work in the phone app, not the web.

t: Totality can take payments from your clients: one-off payment links, cards on file, and products in your shop. How it works depends on whether you're independent or at a gym.

s: Independent trainers: POS add-on and Stripe
t: Independent trainers: POS add-on and Stripe # POS Payments go through Stripe into your own bank account. You need two things: The POS add-on (A$9.99 a month, or in a bundle). It needs a Solo plan. Trainer Payouts set up, which connects your bank through Stripe Connect. Go to Settings > Manage Subscription (or Settings > Stripe Payouts ). On the POS add-on card, tap Add POS, $9.99/mo and pay in Stripe. Back in Totality, scroll to Trainer Payouts and tap Set Up Payouts . Stripe asks for your business details, ID and bank account. Finish every step. While Stripe checks your details the status reads Verification in progress ("This usually takes 1-2 business days"). Then it reads Payouts active . The POS add-on Trainer Payouts with payouts active The button under Trainer Payouts changes with your status: Status Button Not set up Set Up Payouts Verification in progress Continue Setup Account restricted (Stripe needs something) Fix Issues Payouts active View Connect Dashboard If you tap Set Up Payouts without the POS add-on, Totality asks POS Add-on Required and offers Purchase POS Add-on .

The 3.5% platform fee # A 3.5% platform fee applies to POS and marketplace payments. It comes out of your payout before it lands in your bank, and it is never added to what your client pays. It is not a commission on your coaching income. Your Totality plan itself isn't affected.

s: What you can do once it's on
t: What you can do once it's on # Payment links : charge any amount for anything, and send the link by SMS, email or copy. Cards on file : request or add a client's card from their profile. See Client profile . Your shop : sell programmes, PT packages, memberships and anything else. Revenue on Home: this month's earnings, from Stripe. See Marketplace and revenue .

Trainers at a gym # At a gym, payments go to the gym's Stripe account, not to you. You can still take payments with POS when the gym has POS (Studio, Club and Enterprise include it). The POS screen reminds you: "Payments you take here go to your gym's account, not to you." How you're paid by the gym is between you and the gym. You don't need the POS add-on or your own Stripe account at a gym.

Questions # When does Stripe pay me? Stripe pays out to your bank on its normal schedule for your account. Check it in View Connect Dashboard . I'm on Free. Can I take payments? No. The POS add-on needs a Solo plan. You can record cash payments by adding credits by hand. See Credits . Can I use my existing Stripe account? Set Up Payouts walks you through Stripe's own sign-up for a connected account. Follow the steps Stripe shows you there. Who handles refunds? There's no refund button in the Totality app. Email admintotality@gmail.com with the client, amount and date, and the team will help.

t: Independent trainers with the POS add-on can sell to clients through their own shop: programmes, PT packages, memberships and anything else. Money goes to your Stripe account. POS

Open My Products # Go to Shop on Home. Under My Store , tap one of your products, then Manage in Settings → . You can also tap Sell PT packages on any client's profile. Your shop on the My Store tab My Products Until your Stripe payouts are active, a Connect Stripe to sell banner shows and your products stay hidden from clients. You can still create and edit them.

Create a product # In My Products , tap New . Pick a Product type : Programme , PT Package , Membership or Custom . Enter a Name , a Description ("What's included?") and a Price ($) . Fill in the extra field for the type: - Programme : pick which of your programmes the buyer gets. - PT Package : the Number of sessions . When a client pays, they get that many PT credits to book with you. - Membership : the Billing frequency : Weekly , Fortnightly or Monthly . The client is charged on repeat. Optional: Track stock , with Stock on hand and a Low-stock alert at number. Stock goes down by 1 with each sale. Optional: Add buyer as a client , so anyone who buys joins your client list. Leave Active on to show it in your shop. Tap Create product . New product Switch a product off with its toggle to hide it without deleting. Open it and tap Delete product to remove it for good. Products running low show Low stock or Out of stock .

The Shop # Shop on Home has two tabs: My Store (independent trainers): your active products, as clients see them. Filter by type. My Gym (gym trainers): your gym's products, which you can buy. Totality Store : guides and products from Totality you can buy.

Revenue # The Revenue tile on Home shows what you've earned this month. Tap it for the full Revenue screen. If Stripe isn't connected yet, the tile reads "Connect Stripe to see revenue" and takes you to payouts. Pick This Month , Last Month , Last 3 Months or All Time . Totals for the period, number of Transactions and active Memberships . A monthly trend chart and Revenue by product type . Every purchase with the buyer, date, amount, fee and status. Active Memberships with who's on them. The download button at the top exports a CSV. Revenue comes live from your Stripe account and covers the last 90 days. Amounts are shown net of the 3.5% platform fee. Revenue
Purchase history # Settings > Purchase History lists anything you've bought yourself, from trainers, your gym or the Totality Store.

They appear on the client's profile under PT credits once Stripe confirms the payment. Can I sell without the POS add-on? No. Selling needs the POS add-on and active Stripe payouts. I'm at a gym. Can I have my own products? No. At a gym, products are run by the gym admin. You see the gym's products under My Gym .

t: Tali (said "tally") is the assistant inside Totality. She reads your day, spots who's gone quiet and drafts the replies, programmes and nudges. You check everything and decide what gets sent or saved. Tali never sends anything on her own.

Edit it, write another ( Again or Regenerate , which uses another credit), or throw it away. A check-in reply drafted by Tali A nudge drafted by Tali See Check-ins , Waiting on you and Programmes for step by step guides.

Credits # Each plan comes with a monthly allowance that resets each month. Plan Tali credits 7 day trial 50 for the trial Free none Solo 5 50 a month Solo 10 100 a month Solo 20 150 a month Solo 30 200 a month Solo 50 300 a month Solo 100 400 a month Solo 200 600 a month Settings > Tali AI shows your plan, credits left this month and the reset date. Buttons that use credits show how many (for example "Uses 1 credit") and what you have left. Tali AI in Settings

The Tali AI add-on # Paid Need more? The Tali AI add-on adds 1,000 credits a month for A$9.99/mo on any Solo plan. Get it from Settings > Tali AI ( Add Tali: +1,000 credits a month ) or Manage Subscription . It also comes in the POS + AI bundle (A$16.99/mo) and POS + Tali + Branding (A$19.99/mo). On the Free plan # Tali isn't included on Free. Her place on Home explains what she does with a See plans button, and Tali buttons read Add Tali and take you to your plans. Every Solo plan includes her, from 50 credits a month on Solo 5.

Do unused credits carry over? No. The allowance resets each month. Does Tali see my clients' data? Only what she needs for the job you ask: the check-in for a reply, the client's activity for a nudge, onboarding answers for a programme draft when you pick a client. She uses exercises from your library only. Does Tali send messages for me? Never on her own. You tap Send.

t: With the Branding add-on your clients see your logo, business name and colour in the Totality app, in their emails and in push notifications. Leave it blank to use your account name. Brand colour : tap a swatch or type a hex code like #0F766E. Use Totality orange resets it. Your clients will see it next time they open the app." The app icon and name in the app stores stay Totality, and "Powered by Totality" stays in Settings.

Cancel the add-on # On the Branding screen, tap Cancel add-on , then Yes, cancel . Branding stays on until the end of the billing period, then the app goes back to Totality. Access to all coaching tools is now active." It can take a few seconds for Stripe to confirm. If the screen still shows your old plan, leave it and come back. Choose a plan An active Solo plan

s: On a Solo plan: change or manage
t: On a Solo plan: change or manage # The status card shows Active , your plan, and how many clients you have against your limit. Change Plan opens every Solo plan. Pick monthly or yearly and tap Switch to this plan . "Your new plan applies now. The price difference for the rest of this billing period is prorated on your next invoice." Manage Billing opens Stripe's billing page: update your card, see invoices, or cancel. Below that are the add-on cards: Tali AI , Branding and POS , then Trainer Payouts . See Plans and prices and Getting paid . Change Plan

Cancel your plan # Open Settings > Manage Subscription . Tap Manage Billing . Cancel your subscription in Stripe's billing page. When it ends you're on Free : you keep your account, your clients and all their history, with up to 3 active clients and no Tali. Nothing is deleted. Resubscribe any time from the same screen. Add-ons are cancelled the same way, from Manage Billing . The Branding add-on can also be cancelled from the Branding screen.

Delete your account # Settings > Account > Delete Account permanently deletes your account and all your data, and cancels your Totality billing. This can't be undone. If you only want to stop paying, cancel your plan instead and stay on Free.

At a gym # Your Subscription screen shows Gym Partner and the gym's plan. The gym manages billing. If you still had some of your own billing winding down from before you joined, Manage my own billing lets you check or cancel it.

t: Most problems are fixed by one of the steps below. If not, report it and a real person will help.

First, try these # Pull down to refresh the screen you're on. Close the app fully and open it again. Updates arrive over the air, and this loads the latest version. A fresh install still needs one close and reopen. Check your connection. Totality needs internet to load and save. On the web, reload the page at totalityapp.com.au.

Report an issue # The purple ? button floats on every screen (it hides on chat screens so it doesn't cover the send button). Tap ? . Give it a Title and a Description : the steps you took, what you expected and what happened. Pick a Priority : Low, Medium, High or Urgent. Tap Submit . "Your ticket has been submitted. Our team will respond soon." Or email admintotality@gmail.com . Report an Issue

Common problems # A screen shows a spinner forever. Pull down to refresh. If it still spins, close the app fully and reopen it. On the web, reload the page. Their programme and sessions, their food log and targets, their weekly check-in and your replies, their bookings, messages with you, and your shop if you have one. t: Coaching # Can I build a programme once and give it to lots of clients? Yes. Assign it to as many clients as you like. Can I copy last week's session into this week? Yes. Copy from Week N in the session, or Copy week in the programme builder. Do I have to run sessions with my clients? No. Clients can log their own sessions from their app. You see everything they log. What's RPE and why does it matter? Rate of perceived exertion, how hard a set felt out of 10. Auto-regulation uses it to suggest when to change a client's load. Can clients see my coach notes? Yes. Coach notes on an exercise show to the client as "Note from your coach". Private notes on their profile don't.

t: Schedule and payments # Can clients book their own PT sessions? No. You book PT sessions. At a gym, clients can book classes. What's "Pending settlement"? See Getting paid . What fees are there? A 3.5% platform fee on POS and marketplace payments, taken from your payout. It's never added to what your client pays. Does my calendar sync? Yes. Google Calendar two-way, or a one-way link for Google and Apple Calendar. See Calendar sync .
